in_marathi.name: Dhaurya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God's rule, sovereign
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhaurya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Dhaurya is derived from the Sanskrit word 'dhaura' which means 'rule' or 'sovereign'. This name is often given to a child born under the belief that they will rule or govern their domain with wisdom and power.
